newsitem.title: POLAND: Winter ruins 12 pct of Polish grain, rapeseed crop.
newsitem.headline: Winter ruins 12 pct of Polish grain, rapeseed crop.

text.p: The winter has ruined about 12 percent of Poland's grain and rapeseed crop, with about 600,000 hectares in the process of being ploughed under, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said in a statement on Wednesday.

"According to preliminary estimates, to the end of April about 600,000 hectares of grain and rapeseed have been ploughed under or have qualified to be ploughed under, which is about 12 percent of the sown surface area," the statement said.
Last year such losses reached eight percent.
GUS said that this year 400,000 hectares of grain were ruined, 200,000 hectares of it wheat, meaning that 10 percent of that crop as well as 10 percent of all grain crops were killed.
Also 150,000 hectares of rapeseed froze, about 50 percent of that crop.
This year 2.0 million and 2.4 million hectares of wheat and rye respectively were sown, one percent less than last year.
This year 309,000 hectares of rapeseed were sown, 36.4 percent less than last year.
